title: Durchsuchungen wegen des Verdachts des illegalen Waffenbesitzes – Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt und eine Festnahme

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors searched three properties in Spandau and Prenzlauer Berg over illegal weapons possession. Eight illegal firearms, ammunition, phones, data storage devices and cash were seized, and a 28-year-old man was arrested.
